title: The Ghan — Ocean to Ocean through the Red Centre

sub: Adelaide to Darwin — 2,979 km through the Flinders, the red heart and the Top End, with off-train excursions at Marla, Alice and Katherine. Tap a leg to ride it.

days.title: Adelaide into the outback
days.summary: North out of the vineyards, the Flinders Ranges purple at dusk, and the first outback night as the train runs into the red.

stops.name: Adelaide Parklands — boarding
stops.blurb: Champagne on the platform as a kilometre of silver carriages waits to cross a continent.

stops.name: The Flinders Ranges at dusk
stops.blurb: Ancient folded mountains turn purple beyond the saltbush as the dining car pours the Barossa.

stops.name: First night — into the red
stops.blurb: Your cabin made down, the train running steady into the true outback dark — no lights to the horizon.

days.title: Marla dawn to Alice Springs
days.summary: A campfire dawn at Marla, then south Australia gives way to the Territory — into Alice Springs, the heart of the continent.

stops.name: Marla — outback sunrise
stops.blurb: The train pauses in the darkness; fires are lit beside the track and the desert dawn comes up over breakfast.

stops.name: Alice Springs — the red heart
stops.blurb: The town in the MacDonnell gap — an afternoon for the Desert Park, a camel ride, or the flight to Uluru.

stops.name: Simpsons Gap — the West Macs
stops.blurb: A red cleft in the ranges holding permanent water — rock wallabies on the scree at sundown.

days.title: Alice to Katherine — the long red run
days.summary: The centre rolls past all morning — the Devils Marbles off in the scrub — then the tropics begin and the gorge country of Katherine.

stops.name: Karlu Karlu — the Devils Marbles
stops.blurb: Giant granite spheres balanced on the plain — a sacred place of the Warumungu, glowing at first light.

stops.name: Nitmiluk Gorge cruise
stops.blurb: Off the train at Katherine for a cruise between hundred-metre sandstone walls — freshwater crocs on the banks.

stops.name: Dinner crossing the tropics
stops.blurb: Barramundi and Territory beef as the light turns green and gold — the desert already a thousand kilometres behind.

days.title: Katherine to Darwin — the Top End finale
days.summary: Through the Top End's woodland and river country, over the Elizabeth to the Timor Sea — ocean to ocean, complete.

stops.name: The Adelaide River country
stops.blurb: Floodplains, magnetic termite mounds and the big rivers of the Top End sliding past the window.

stops.name: Darwin — ocean to ocean
stops.blurb: The line ends at the Timor Sea — sunset on the waterfront, a continent crossed top to bottom.

stops.name: Stokes Hill Wharf — landfall dinner
stops.blurb: Chilli prawns and cold beer over the harbour where the journey ends.
